summary: Implemented the sole authorized Pro Proposal 6 bounded audit as a frozen rank-32 reduced G14 pair-tile recursion. The complete unrestricted depth-two tables through squared radius 57 are closed, but the obstruction/control minima are 57 and 32 and the measured growth factors satisfy lambda=57/32<mu=2, so this serialized recursion rule fails its required growth inequality. This is finite evidence only.
hypothesis: Complete full-assignment ports and exact min-plus gluing might force illegal transfer cost to grow strictly faster than legal cost; the falsification condition was nonclosure, an omitted attack class, control mismatch, or lambda<=mu.

tests.finding: Exact unrestricted obstruction/control squared minima are 57 and 32; all three depth-one tables have 20 entries, the obstruction depth-two table has eight ILLEGAL entries at 57, the control has one LEGAL entry at 32, and lambda=57/32<mu=2.
The verifier compiles and the serialized complete-table manifest is valid JSON.

next_experiment: If the frozen-tile direction is continued, retain the same exhaustive closure contract but test one uncontracted size-16 four-variable G14 pair bag with a nontrivial overlap seam; derive its coefficient bound before enumeration and kill immediately on nonclosure, control mismatch, or lambda<=mu.
